about: Amazon's upload templates are category-specific and change without notice. These are the commonly documented core flat-file columns, plus Amazon.in's hsn_code and maximum_retail_price.
Download your category's template in Seller Central (Inventory > Add Products via Upload) and copy these values into it. Column names in your downloaded template win over the ones here.
Yellow cells are details KaarigarAI doesn't collect: fill them before uploading.

columns.not_collected: the product type Amazon uses for your category; pick it from your downloaded template
your brand name as printed on the product or its packaging (a GTIN exemption needs photos showing it)
barcode (GTIN/EAN). Handmade items without one can apply for a GTIN exemption in Seller Central
EAN, UPC or GTIN, matching the barcode above; leave empty if you have a GTIN exemption

columns.note: set to your listing price; if the product has a printed MRP, use that instead (standard_price can't be above it)
the product cut out on a white background, as Amazon asks for main images (unless the cut-out failed, then the photo as taken)

columns.if_empty: material wasn't confirmed for this listing
material wasn't confirmed for this listing

columns.not_collected: the GST HSN code for your product
